responsibilities: Zassenhaus Round-2 local maximal-order iteration
nilradical and multiplier-ring kernels over FLINT storage
exact packed-integer order-basis transformations and p-squared multiplier equations with exact fallbacks
files.rationale: The strict ordinary-Python implementation remains the primary readable algorithm. This host-neutral batched kernel preserves its Round-2 control flow while using sparse radical RREF rows to form p-squared multiplier equations, exact hash deduplication, a single p-squared reduction with a derived p image, packed integer basis transforms, reusable workspaces, checked sparse basis addmul transforms, power-of-two low-limb reduction, and a conservatively bounded signed-word multiplication tensor with lazy exact synchronization. It compacts exact duplicate and zero multiplier equations before the FLINT nullspace. The radical trace pairing precomputes the traces of the algebra basis and uses linearity of the regular representation to form the exact pairing in cubic rather than quartic time; the original entrywise matrix-product construction remains a compile-time differential oracle. For the canonical Round-2 block change [I R; 0 pI], the exact tensor transform preserves nonpivot products, divides mixed products only by p, divides only the pivot block by p-squared, and fills the symmetric half by commutativity; the forced generic lattice-inverse transform remains the differential oracle. At terminal degree-at-most-64 word-prime precision for p at most 251 it keeps the exact multiplication tensor modulo a proof-carrying p-power, projects the mod-p and mod-p-squared tables from that state, and consumes exactly two p-adic digits per accepted [I R; 0 pI] enlargement after checking exact p and p-squared divisibility. Precision exhaustion replays the immutable prime-boundary state at the required precision. Beginning at the measured degree-64 crossover, batches with pairwise-coprime proved primes use bounded native lanes to compute every local overorder from the immutable source order. Their scaled basis generators contain the common denominator times the equation lattice, so that denominator bounds the largest elementary divisor and certifies FLINT's modular tall-HNF merge; a forced generic HNF, a forced compounded sequential path, and a correct single-lane fallback where pthreads are unavailable remain exact differentials. Every accelerated step retains an exact fallback because the native compiler still lacks a general packed three-dimensional fmpz value type.
files.fallback: The complete ordinary-Python Round-2 implementation and the forced original exact lattice-inverse path remain correct for every supported prime. Both are exercised against deterministic randomized optimized-versus-exact differentials; the native word-prime path is an optional acceleration.
files.next: Replace this exception with source-transparent native lowering when packed exact multiplication tables, modular kernels, and rational basis changes are expressible in the typed compiler.

files.rationale: This fuses discriminant, cheap decomposition, and partial local-order work into one native call while preserving every lazy residual exactly. It also verifies terminal fixed points from a completed canonical order without rerunning enlargement, sharing one exact multiplication table across deterministic per-prime jobs. The handwritten FLINT representation boundary is a measured compiler exception: the source-transparent degree-64 O(n^4) replay took 18.185s, versus 2.356s for the three-prime FLINT resource producer. The ordinary source remains the independent mathematical oracle.
files.fallback: Externally supplied, copied, or malformed packed proofs are never directly trusted: the ordinary-Python source-transparent checker recomputes the discriminant, HNF/index/order closure, exact multiplication table, and every fixed point. Fast authentication exists only synchronously around an actual current generated native call and immediately matches its canonical metadata, polynomial, caller-order prime list, witness shape, and basis before sealing. Worker allocation is bounded to five lanes under 512 MiB, pthread-creation failure runs the missing lane synchronously, and native Windows uses the exact sequential path.
files.next: Retain the immutable payload boundary, but migrate bounded decomposition, dispatch, and fixed-point replay to typed source-transparent Python once exact FLINT polynomial and matrix resources compile without object-at-a-time crossings. If post-construction verification misses the public budget, add an optional proof-carrying order mode so local Round-2 workers retain terminal radical/minor witnesses before cleanup and authentication consumes construction-time evidence.
